Here's a number of sites that you should check out. First up it's [Surfers Against Sewage][239].
Campaigning for clean water should be something you'd be interested in. They are UK based, and the
US equivalent is the [Surfrider Foundation][240].

Also, check out [Save the Waves Coalition][241], saving the world's endangered waves. Do try to
support these charitable organisations working for water users everywhere.

We're working on your behalf also. We have a free [rss feed widget][242], embeddable surf maps and
surfing games to use on your website / blog.

support these charitable organisations working for water users everywhere.

## Located in Oceanside, and Solana Beach. Surf Ride Boardshops are Californias premier surf retail
## stores. 

 

Surf Ride was founded in 1974 by twin brothers Bill and Richard Bernard with the original and
flagship location being in Oceanside on Coast Hwy.  

Bill and Richard started out in a little 800 sqf adobe building on what was then called "Hill
Street" in Oceanside CA.  Originally a Hobie Cat dealership with a focus on the core sports of the
ocean.  As sailing became less popular and every time it rained in Oceanside the adobe building
would leak water through the walls and the streets would flood the front door, the brothers decided
it was time to build a new building.  They knew that they needed one that could fulfill the dreams
they had of becoming Californias premier destination shop for all things SURF!

In 1984 they began construction on what is now Surf Ride.  The building was originally split into 3
different business with a restaurant on the side.  As business improved and the need for more space
was fulfilled by tearing down walls and expanding the surf department.  Business was booming for
surf and after 13 years they decided it was time to open an second location.  In 1997 the Solan
Beach location was opened up.  The 7,500 sqf store was custom built from the ground up to house the
largest surfboard selection in California.  

By 2005 the brothers had both had enough of the daily grind and decided to retire and let the next
generation take over the business.  Dustin and Josh Bernard stepped in to let their dad and uncle
chase the dream of sailing the South Pacific and surfing perfect waves in warm water.  Today, Dustin
is actively shaping surfboards for Surf Ride under the SR/MFG label and Josh is the active CEO of
Surf Ride.  

Surf Ride Boardshops are truly one of the last surviving core family owned surf shops in AMERICA.
 Surf Ride specializes in having the best boards, wetsuits, and clothing that the surf industry has
to offer.  They also have an amazing fleet of rental boards both foam boards and custom hand shaped
epoxy boards.  During the summer Surf Ride Surf Camp is the best place for kids to learn how to
surf!  

Next time you're in San Diego make sure to stop by, say hello and give us a HIGH FIVE!!

About Surfway
Since 2013 over 100 000 students attended surf classes, joined surf trips and caught unforgettable
waves with our club in Indonesia, Brazil, Morocco, Angola and many other surf destinations. Using
our experience, we built the Surfway ecosystem — a clear, proven surfing pathway that takes riders
from their very first steps to confident ocean surfing. It includes surfing the ocean and artificial
waves, surfskate, wakesurfing, land training etc. This system accelerates progress safely and
consistently for any level of surfing.

Our partnership with PerfectSwell**®** Hainan is an exciting next step: cutting-edge wave technology
meets proven coaching methodology, creating the best environment for growth and pure surfing joy.
Choose Your Experience
Surfway offers three options to fully enjoy surfing and island life on Hainan.
* Surf PerfectSwell
* Surf the ocean
* For club/group leaders
Surf PerfectSwell Surf the ocean For club/group leaders
For those looking to level up
PerfectSwell® creates consistent conditions for dynamic training and upgrading your surfing level.
No waiting for swell, full independence from wind or tides — just faster progression with many more
attempts.
Group surf training
We run structured group sessions with professional coaching from the Surfway team.

Progress becomes noticeable from the very first session.
Sessions with custom wave presets
Personalized sessions with customized wave settings, tailored to your goals. All 17 configurations
are available, whether you’re working on maneuvers, airs or barrels.
Surfing in the ocean, sightseeing trips on Hainan and continental China
Hainan also can be recognized as a good destination for surfing the natural waves. There are many
spots for different type of boards and conditions. During free time you can enjoy sightseeing
remarkable places on the island itself and in continental China.
Excursions on Hainan and Continental China
We help our guests to discover the island’s and Continental Chinamost memorable natural and cultural
locations: tropical parks, historic temples, panoramic viewpoints, ethnic villages, scenic beaches
and of course — Great Wall of China.
Perfect waves, comfortable accommodation, and the full experience of a premium surf resort
We arrange stays at the surf hotel or boutique hotel and provide access to everything the surf
resort offers — the wave pool, restaurants, retail spaces, relaxation zones, skatepark, and the
coastline.
Community, club & team programs
We design and deliver customized surf trips for communities, clubs, and organizations:
Surfway — your surf partner on Hainan. We are creating hand-crafted surf tours depending on your
request and needs. We are sure that Hainan will become one of your top destinations and product
From group camps and corporate retreats to specialized training formats and branded integrations.

Why Pro Surfers Choose
PerfectSwell® is the advanced artificial wave technology, developed by American Wave Machines
2−3x faster improvement: many more attempts per session
Minimum paddling: more surfing, less getting tired
17 wave settings: from first steps to air/barrel sessions
Real ocean-like shape and power
Instead of mechanical paddles or moving walls, it uses precise compressed-air pulses released
through dozens of chambers along the pool wall. The technology creates waves from 0.5 to 3 meters
of height with a period of 6 seconds and rides up to 18 seconds. There are 17 wave modes designed
for different levels and training goals.

With fine-tuned control PerfectSwell® recreates the real feel of the ocean — from beginner level
to fast and powerful waves with sections for advanced maneuvers, airs and barrels.
It’s the only technology that produces a naturally "breathing" wave, rather than simply pushing the
water
Inside the Hainan Surf Resort
Riyue Bay Surf Resort with The PerfectSwell® technology is located in Wanning, Hainan Island.
It is a modern, thoughtfully designed surf destination, a self-contained mini-city where world-class
waves and relaxed island living come together.
The resort offers two hotel options: a functional surf hotel right next to the wave and a stylish
boutique hotel in a quieter, more secluded area. And remember that there are a lot of surf spots
with natural waves really close by.

**FAQ**
Why PerfectSwell® technology is unique? 
PerfectSwell® technology creates ocean-type waves with the natural feeling of speed and power. There
exist 17 different levels of wave types.
Can the beginner surf PerfectSwell® wave?
Yes. There levels with soft waves where anyone can make first steps in surfing.
Do I need to have my personal surfboard?
You can use your personal one or rent.
Options of payments
We accept payments with international bank cards.
Can I have a session with coaching included?
Yes. Surfway coach can assist and train students during session in the water.

You can use your personal one or rent.

# REPAIRS

## With our quality repairs, SydneySurfboardRepair.com.au go to great detail in colouring
## (disguising) every job that comes through our doors. Colour matching is included in all listed
## prices.

[
[On a wave after fin repair][On a wave after fin repair]
][9]

Fin systems and fin box repairs – We re-fit FCSII and the original FCS plug system, Futures, Single
fin box systems. As you can see in the picture above, after a fin repair with us, the board is still
performing.

[
[nose damage][nose damage]
][10]

Nose or tail – It is a common repair at the extremity of any surfboard ie: nose and tail repairs,
can be rebuilt quite nicely. Sharp edges and leaking regarding these damages are important to be
fixed asap as there are dangers related to the board and the rider if left unattended.

[
[rail damage][rail damage]
][11]

Rail repairs – If you have cracked, shattered, fin chopped, dented, creased, crushed or smashed
rail. We can rebuild whatever your damage is back to as new condition.

[
[board crease][board crease]
][12]

Crease – In a technical sense a crease is a compression of the fibreglass resulting in lifting away
from the foam or compressing down into the foam. A remedy to a creased surfboard is best not left
unattended as the overall integrity of the surfboards strength is compromised, potentially resulting
in further damage or even a complete snap.

[
[sup damage][sup damage]
][13]

SUPs – All the above mentioned processes apply to stand up paddle boards, SUPs.

All SUP’s are of styrofoam and epoxy construction with externally applied paint systems on both
counts attracting a greater repair cost. Along with this extra expense is the handling and storage
issues relating to large items. Ie: SUPs and clubbie racing boards.

[
[legrope plug][legrope plug]
][14]

Legrope plugs – If your legrope plug is leaking, loose or completely torn out. We can re-install a
new legrope plug.


## WHAT WE FIX

## We repair the most up to date composite surfboard construction systems and brands such as JS
## Industries, DHD, Channel Islands, Firewire.

[
[On a wave after fin repair][On a wave after fin repair]
][9]

Fin systems and fin box repairs – We re-fit FCSII and the original FCS plug system, Futures, Single
fin box systems. As you can see in the picture above, after a fin repair with us, the board is still
performing.

[
[nose damage][nose damage]
][10]

Nose or tail – It is a common repair at the extremity of any surfboard ie: nose and tail repairs,
can be rebuilt quite nicely. Sharp edges and leaking regarding these damages are important to be
fixed asap as there are dangers related to the board and the rider if left unattended.

[
[rail damage][rail damage]
][11]

Rail repairs – If you have cracked, shattered, fin chopped, dented, creased, crushed or smashed
rail. We can rebuild whatever your damage is back to as new condition.

[
[board crease][board crease]
][12]

Crease – In a technical sense a crease is a compression of the fibreglass resulting in lifting away
from the foam or compressing down into the foam. A remedy to a creased surfboard is best not left
unattended as the overall integrity of the surfboards strength is compromised, potentially resulting
in further damage or even a complete snap.

[
[sup damage][sup damage]
][13]

SUPs – All the above mentioned processes apply to stand up paddle boards, SUPs.

All SUP’s are of styrofoam and epoxy construction with externally applied paint systems on both
counts attracting a greater repair cost. Along with this extra expense is the handling and storage
issues relating to large items. Ie: SUPs and clubbie racing boards.

[
[legrope plug][legrope plug]
][14]

Legrope plugs – If your legrope plug is leaking, loose or completely torn out. We can re-install a
new legrope plug.

## Industries, DHD, Channel Islands, Firewire.

### [ Longboard tails, explained. ][181]

# **Which tail shape is best for my longboard surfboard?**

Understanding tail shapes can make it easier to find a longboard that suits your style and
aspirations. While tail shape significantly impacts how a board responds, the mechanics are quite
simple once you know what to look for.

We have broken down our longboard tail shapes below to help you understand how each one performs. If
a particular shape interests you, please use the links provided to view the relevant Thomas
Surfboards models.

[ Blog ][182]

## QUALITY GUARANTEED

Thomas Surfboards is a custom surfboards manufacturer based in Noosa Heads, Australia, led by shaper
Thomas Bexon and glasser Jake Bowrey.

We provide surfers with access to high quality, custom surfboards, from every era of surfboard
design. Further to that, we’re committed to creating places and spaces where surfboard design,
culture and construction is revered.

[ read on.. ][183]
[Load video: ]

# **ABOUT OUR BOARDS**

#### **Our designs are focused on the principle of trim, which promotes maximum flow with minimum
#### effort. We believe that a well designed surfboard amplifies the energy of the wave, generating
#### its own speed and momentum, leaving you to focus on the enjoyment of surfing. Longboard
#### surfboards, or logs, are great for everyone from beginners to experts, and while your level and
#### desired outcomes will determine the exact size and shape of your board, it’s not uncommon for
#### people of all levels to ride the same longboard design. Our longboards typically range in size
#### from 9’0” to 10’3”, and the length and style you choose will depend on your height, weight,
#### physical abilities, and the types of waves you surf. **

#### **In our longboards, we incorporate a balance of features that promote noseriding, trimming and
#### turning. Most important, in our eyes, is trim, which affects the flow of the surfboard and
#### connects you from the tail to the nose. From there, if your focus is noseriding, we can design
#### a board with that in mind, and the same can be said for turning. However, a board designed with
#### a focus on turning will lose some noseriding capability, and vice versa. Generally speaking, we
#### prefer not to go too far in either direction - we like well balanced surfboards - but
#### ultimately, the decision is yours. **

#### **The same can be said for our mid lengths, which are renowned for their versatility, having
#### been ridden in everything from knee high to double overhead + waves. Inspired by classic
#### egg-shape surfboards, our mid lengths have long, smooth outlines, generous amounts of volume
#### for paddle power, low rockers for fast trim speeds, and contemporary rail shapes and bottom
#### contours for increased turning ability. With slight adjustments, we can customise our
#### mid-lengths to better suit someone from a shortboard or longboard background - a learner or an
#### advanced surfer. And our shortboards follow in the same vein. With everything from the classic
#### Fish, to hybrids, and even modern shortboards, we offer the full gamut of shortboard design. **

#### **Outside of design, our major focus is quality. We use only the best blanks and resin, and our
#### staff take the utmost care in every step of the board building process. We build the absolute
#### highest quality custom surfboards, and with over twenty years of experience doing so, we’re
#### confident in our ability to create whatever it is that you’re after. **

#### **Need help selecting the right surfboard for you? Or want something very customised and
#### particular? **[**Shoot us a message and we'll put you in touch with head shaper and co-creator
#### Thomas Bexon, to discuss what you’re looking for. **][184]

# **Which tail shape is best for my longboard surfboard?**

Understanding tail shapes can make it easier to find a longboard that suits your style and
aspirations. While tail shape significantly impacts how a board responds, the mechanics are quite
simple once you know what to look for.

We have broken down our longboard tail shapes below to help you understand how each one performs. If
a particular shape interests you, please use the links provided to view the relevant Thomas
Surfboards models.

[ Blog ][182]

## QUALITY GUARANTEED

Thomas Surfboards is a custom surfboards manufacturer based in Noosa Heads, Australia, led by shaper
Thomas Bexon and glasser Jake Bowrey.

We provide surfers with access to high quality, custom surfboards, from every era of surfboard
design. Further to that, we’re committed to creating places and spaces where surfboard design,
culture and construction is revered.

[ read on.. ][183]
[Load video: ]

# **ABOUT OUR BOARDS**

#### **Our designs are focused on the principle of trim, which promotes maximum flow with minimum
#### effort. We believe that a well designed surfboard amplifies the energy of the wave, generating
#### its own speed and momentum, leaving you to focus on the enjoyment of surfing. Longboard
#### surfboards, or logs, are great for everyone from beginners to experts, and while your level and
#### desired outcomes will determine the exact size and shape of your board, it’s not uncommon for
#### people of all levels to ride the same longboard design. Our longboards typically range in size
#### from 9’0” to 10’3”, and the length and style you choose will depend on your height, weight,
#### physical abilities, and the types of waves you surf. **

#### **In our longboards, we incorporate a balance of features that promote noseriding, trimming and
#### turning. Most important, in our eyes, is trim, which affects the flow of the surfboard and
#### connects you from the tail to the nose. From there, if your focus is noseriding, we can design
#### a board with that in mind, and the same can be said for turning. However, a board designed with
#### a focus on turning will lose some noseriding capability, and vice versa. Generally speaking, we
#### prefer not to go too far in either direction - we like well balanced surfboards - but
#### ultimately, the decision is yours. **

#### **The same can be said for our mid lengths, which are renowned for their versatility, having
#### been ridden in everything from knee high to double overhead + waves. Inspired by classic
#### egg-shape surfboards, our mid lengths have long, smooth outlines, generous amounts of volume
#### for paddle power, low rockers for fast trim speeds, and contemporary rail shapes and bottom
#### contours for increased turning ability. With slight adjustments, we can customise our
#### mid-lengths to better suit someone from a shortboard or longboard background - a learner or an
#### advanced surfer. And our shortboards follow in the same vein. With everything from the classic
#### Fish, to hybrids, and even modern shortboards, we offer the full gamut of shortboard design. **

#### **Outside of design, our major focus is quality. We use only the best blanks and resin, and our
#### staff take the utmost care in every step of the board building process. We build the absolute
#### highest quality custom surfboards, and with over twenty years of experience doing so, we’re
#### confident in our ability to create whatever it is that you’re after. **

#### **Need help selecting the right surfboard for you? Or want something very customised and
#### particular? **[**Shoot us a message and we'll put you in touch with head shaper and co-creator
#### Thomas Bexon, to discuss what you’re looking for. **][184]

easier to control on time delivery & high-quality.

With rich experience and a pursuit of high-quality products, we have successfully taken a leading

## Shaping the Future of Surfing Since 1965

Founded in 1965 by Steve Walden, known as 'The Father of the Modern Longboard,' Walden Surfboards
has been shaping the future of surfing for 60 years. Always ahead of the curve, Walden has pioneered
high-performance, innovative longboards by embracing new materials, constructions, and designs. His
commitment to accessibility ensures that surfers of all levels—from beginners to seasoned riders—can
experience the perfect board. Still at the helm, Steve continues to design, shape, and personally
connect with customers, keeping the Walden legacy alive.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT STEVE'S LEGACY][130]

## Built for the ride

Steve Walden designs and shapes high-performance surfboards, best known for the revolutionary Magic
Model, a longboard designed to ride like a short board. It's agile, fast, and maneuverable with a
big sweet spot for a high wave count. The iconic Magic Model has evened the playing field, allowing
beginners and pros to excel.

## Shaping the Future of Surfing Since 1965

Founded in 1965 by Steve Walden, known as 'The Father of the Modern Longboard,' Walden Surfboards
has been shaping the future of surfing for 60 years. Always ahead of the curve, Walden has pioneered
high-performance, innovative longboards by embracing new materials, constructions, and designs. His
commitment to accessibility ensures that surfers of all levels—from beginners to seasoned riders—can
experience the perfect board. Still at the helm, Steve continues to design, shape, and personally
connect with customers, keeping the Walden legacy alive.

beginners and pros to excel.

  Performing arenas with Jack Johnson + Conner Coffin and Matt Costa jam sesh | COLD BEER SURF CLUB
  Singer-songwriter, producer and filmmaker Matt Costa joins the 805 Beer Cold Beer Surf Club with
  Conner Coffin for a conversation about music, surfing, filmmaking, and all the unexpected moments
  that helped shape his life. Costa shares how he is inspired by surf trips when coming up with
  inspiration for surf films like Burn, A Brokedown Melody, and other films with the Moonshine
  Conspiracy with Jack Johnson and Emmett Malloy. He opens up about his upbringing in Southern
  California, and the skateboarding injury that closed the door on his professional skateboarding
  career, but led to his music career. Matt also discusses previous collaborations with Jack Johnson
  and Brushfire Records, touring for massive crowds, and hints at a new cross-country passion

  Dora's dominance, Lindblad's rise, & People On Tour BTS in Saq Town | The Lineup EM PORTUGUÊS
  People On Tour creator Pedro Burckauser joins WSL social media manager Pedro Brasil on The Lineup
  podcast to break down everything that happened at the VIVO Rio Pro Presented by Corona Cero, for
  the first time, in an entirely Portuguese episode. Fresh off an unforgettable week in Saquarema,
  the two Pedros recap Yago Dora's incredible victory, João Chianca's impressive run, Luana Silva's
  continued rise, and why Leonardo Fioravanti's run to the Final, and his first-ever Yellow Leader
  Jersey, was one of the biggest stories of the event. They also discuss the atmosphere that makes
  the Brazil stop one of the most unique events on Tour, the weather challenges that shaped the
  competition, the CT Shaper Rankings, fan questions, and plenty of behind-the-scenes stories from
  life on the road following the Championship Tour.
